title: HASHI–Frontend Essential Live Acceptance
description: A short, real-runtime acceptance suite for the HASHI lifecycle, remote topology, backend completion, and an external frontend such as Workbench.

items.title: Frontend command round-trip
operator_steps: In the external frontend, select the exact instance and Agent recorded for this run.
Send /status and wait for the final response.
Confirm the response appears once in the selected Session and the Agent returns to idle.
pass_criteria: The command reaches the intended HASHI instance and Agent.
The final response is rendered exactly once and no request remains stuck.

items.title: Remote topology and discovery
operator_steps: Send /remote from the selected Session.
Compare the visible connected instances with the expected test topology.
Refresh once and confirm the topology remains usable.
pass_criteria: All expected instances are present and connected.
The remote view refreshes without losing the selected Session or command path.

items.title: Dynamic menu persistence
operator_steps: Open the /sys dynamic card, then open the /reboot mode card without selecting a lifecycle action yet.
Capture a screenshot, wait at least 30 seconds, switch to another Session or instance and return, and allow transcript refresh.
Capture another screenshot and confirm both cards did not flash away, collapse unexpectedly, or click through to content underneath.
pass_criteria: Dynamic cards survive transcript refresh and navigation within their validity period.
Visible controls remain clickable, keyboard reachable, and spatially stable.

items.title: Targeted /reboot min
operator_steps: Capture a pre-reboot snapshot with this runner.
Use the visible /reboot card to select min for the recorded Agent.
Wait for an online terminal receipt, capture a post-reboot snapshot, and compare them with Core PID=same and Core digest=same.
Send a benign follow-up message and confirm the targeted Agent responds.
pass_criteria: The selected Agent Worker adopts the requested Function generation and returns online.
The Core PID and all protected Core source hashes remain unchanged.
The frontend command chain remains usable after adoption.

items.title: Broad /reboot max
operator_steps: Capture a pre-reboot snapshot with this runner.
Use the visible /reboot card to select max.
Wait for an online terminal receipt covering shared Functions, Workers, and Remote; capture a post-reboot snapshot and compare with Core PID=same and Core digest=same.
Confirm the selected Agent and remote topology are responsive.
pass_criteria: All required Function and Worker generations return online with Remote healthy.
The Core PID and all protected Core source hashes remain unchanged.
No unrelated frontend Session is lost.

items.title: /restart while preserving an unsent draft
operator_steps: Open two frontend tabs for the same Session. In tab A, type a unique unsent draft and capture it without sending.
Capture a pre-restart snapshot. In tab B, issue /restart and complete its confirmation flow.
Wait for reconnection, capture a post-restart snapshot, and compare with Core PID=changed and Core digest=same.
Return to tab A and verify the draft text is byte-for-byte unchanged; then send a benign message to confirm the chain is live.
pass_criteria: The old Core exits and a different healthy Core PID serves the same instance.
Protected Core source and the checked-out commit remain unchanged.
The external frontend reconnects and preserves the exact unsent draft.

items.title: Remote recovery after restart
operator_steps: After restart reconnection, send /remote again.
Confirm all expected instances return and the dynamic view remains usable after one refresh.
pass_criteria: Remote discovery and authentication recover after Core replacement.
No stale or duplicate instance entry blocks normal use.

items.title: Backend completion exits cleanly
operator_steps: Send a small bounded task that requires a final response but no long-running job.
After the final response appears, wait for the frontend to show idle and send one more short message.
Do not use /stop unless this item has already failed and the stuck process must be recovered.
pass_criteria: The backend process exits naturally after the final response.
The Session releases its active slot and accepts the next message without /stop.

items.title: Desktop and compact layout review
operator_steps: Capture the conversation, dynamic card, and composer at the normal desktop width.
Capture the same surfaces at a compact or narrow supported width.
Inspect for clipping, overlap, unintended horizontal scroll, hidden state text, and undersized controls.
pass_criteria: No important content or controls are clipped, obscured, or overlapping.
State, focus, progress, and disabled feedback remain understandable at both widths.
